product.name: Lians
product.category: Smarter AI memory: more useful work per token
product.summary: On the published LoCoMo benchmark, Lians reached 90.0% judged accuracy with 85.4% fewer context tokens than full-context prompting. Lians applies that less-but-better context approach to help AI reduce prompt bloat and processing latency while preserving trustworthy memory and evidence from personal assistants to enterprise systems.

workflow.label: Remember
workflow.detail: Keep the facts, preferences, decisions, outcomes, and reviewed lessons that matter across conversations and applications.

workflow.label: Focus
workflow.detail: Retrieve the smallest useful context instead of making a model reread everything, reducing token waste and avoidable processing latency.

workflow.label: Improve
workflow.detail: Carry forward outcomes and reviewed lessons so AI can make better use of every token without keeping stale facts alive.

workflow.label: Prove
workflow.detail: Preserve the evidence, policies, tools, and review trail needed to explain important decisions at personal or enterprise scale.

surfaces.label: Everyday AI
surfaces.detail: Portable memory for personal assistants that should remember preferences, projects, and past decisions across sessions.

surfaces.label: Developer library
surfaces.detail: Local-first Python and multi-language tools for adding token-budgeted memory and decision evidence to an application.

surfaces.label: Enterprise platform
surfaces.detail: Self-hosted Postgres and pgvector deployment with governance, information barriers, audit chains, and investigation workflows.

surfaces.label: Managed cloud
surfaces.detail: A managed path for individuals and organizations that want Lians operated for them rather than running the platform themselves.
